definition: A learning automaton is one type of machine learning algorithm studied since 1970s.
details: Learning automata select their current action based on past experiences from the environment. It will fall into the range of reinforcement learning if the environment is stochastic and a Markov decision process (MDP) is used.
story: Think of a lightbulb moment: the idea was always there, but someone had to point a finger at it. Boil it down and it is this: A learning automaton is one type of machine learning algorithm studied since 1970s. Here is why it matters: Learning automata select their current action based on past experiences from the environment. Once you see it, you cannot unsee it. And that idea, made concrete, is Learning automaton.
